name: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters
description:
About This Game

■ Game Overview

Mythmon is a hack-and-slash strategy game where you build the ultimate monster party to take down the Demon King's army.

As the commander, you'll combine Mythmon, equipment, and formations before heading into battle. Combat unfolds automatically, so careful preparation is the key to victory.

Recruit from a roster of 30 unique Mythmon, equip them with over 140 pieces of gear, and experiment with countless team combinations to forge the ultimate party and save the world from the Demon King's invasion!

■ Mythmon

The stars of the game are the adorable Mythic Monsters, better known as Mythmon!

Each Mythmon has its own unique characteristics, and as they level up, you can choose new traits for them to learn.

Raise them into your ideal companions!

■ Party Formation

Build a party of up to five Mythmon and assign them to one of three roles: sturdy frontliners, agile midliners, or hard-hitting backliners. Experiment with equipment, over 10 different status effects, and trait synergies to discover the optimal formation for your team!

■ Thrilling High-Stakes Battles

The heart of the game is its thrilling battle for equipment! Win, and you'll claim the powerful weapon your enemy was carrying, instantly strengthening your party. Lose, and one of your own weapons will be taken instead, making the Demon King's army even stronger. Will you press the attack or make a tactical retreat? The outcome of every battle depends on the decisions you make.

Mythmon Streaming & Video Posting Guidelines

The Mythmon Video Posting Guidelines ("Guidelines") set forth the conditions under which you may post gameplay videos of Mythmon ("Game") on the internet, including live streams (collectively, "post" or "posting"). By complying with these Guidelines, you may post gameplay videos of the Game.

No prior permission or individual notification is required, provided your videos comply with these Guidelines.

■ Gameplay Videos You May Post

Under these Guidelines, you may post videos of gameplay that you (or another player appearing in the video together with you) have personally played. Videos of gameplay that you did not personally play are not covered by these Guidelines.

You may also use screenshots from the Game as thumbnails for your gameplay videos. (Gameplay videos and such thumbnails are collectively referred to as "Gameplay Videos" in these Guidelines.)

■ Editing Gameplay Videos

You may freely edit or modify your Gameplay Videos, including by creating commentary videos featuring your own voice or appearance.

However, you must comply with the following conditions.

➀ Do not extract and use individual elements from the Game, such as background music, character artwork, or other assets, on their own.

➁ Do not edit or modify Gameplay Videos in a way that infringes the rights of any third party.

➂ Do not excessively edit or alter Gameplay Videos in a way that misrepresents or obscures the content of the Game.

■ Prohibited Activities

When posting Gameplay Videos, you must not engage in any of the following activities. Regardless of whether any of the following prohibitions apply, if we request that a Gameplay Video be removed, you must promptly delete it.

・Posting for commercial purposes. However, monetization through the built-in monetization features of the video-sharing or streaming platform on which the Gameplay Video is posted will not be considered a commercial purpose for the purposes of these Guidelines.

・Posting for the purpose of religious or political activities.

・Including unlawful content, content contrary to public order and morals, or combining Gameplay Videos with such content.

・Reposting or reuploading Gameplay Videos created by third parties without their permission.
short_desc: Build the ultimate monster party and defeat the Demon King in this hack-and-slash strategy game! Combine quirky Mythmon, equipment, and formations to craft the perfect strategy and lead your forces to victory!
